summary: Black Hawk Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting a $150,000 deposit to its trust account to extend its deadline to complete an initial business combination by one month, from August 22, 2026 to September 22, 2026. This routine extension payment is a standard SPAC administrative mechanism, not a corporate action altering shareholder rights or constituting a special situation. No terms of a business combination, tender offer, or liquidation are disclosed. The filing merely updates the combination deadline. The next critical milestone is the September 22, 2026 deadline.
